feed.title: Arxo Findings Register
feed.subtitle: Verified discrepancies in legal texts, official publications and implementations, with evidence and correction histories.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0024 — Rabbit grading, paragraph 10: the Russian and Kazakh texts set opposite culling conditions
entry.summary: Reported. The Russian text of paragraph 10 recommends culling does “that raised fewer than 5 kits in each of the first two kindlings” and those with “more than two consecutive misses”. The Kazakh text of the same paragraph names does that raised “at least 5 kits” and misses “twice in a row”. The condition on the number of kits is reversed between the language versions, and the number of misses differs.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0023 — 2026 energy taxation guide: the ED95 rate is 12.119 €/MWh on page 25 but 12.157 €/MWh on pages 33 and 37
entry.summary: Reported. We compared the « Guide 2026 sur la fiscalité des énergies » published by the Ministry of Ecological Transition (editions of 30 May and 22 July 2026) with article L. 312-79 of the Code of taxes on goods and services (CIBS). Page 25 and article L. 312-79 give 12.119 €/MWh for ethanol-diesel ED95, while page 33 (annex 2) and page 37 (annex 3, 6.43 €/hL) give 12.157 €/MWh, although 6.43 × 3.6 / 1.91 = 12.119. The discrepancy is in the guide; the rate in the code is not affected.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0022 — CSS art. L. 162-23-8 on Légifrance, version from 1 September 2027: both changes made by the 2026 social security financing act are missing
entry.summary: Reported. Article 72, I, 5°, of Law No. 2025-1403 deletes « part prévue au 2° du I de l'article L. 162-23, affectée à la » from the first paragraph of I of article L. 162-23-8 of the Social Security Code and inserts « exerçant les activités mentionnées au 4° du même article L. 162-22 ». The version in force until 1 September 2027 (LEGIARTI000053283299) contains both changes; the version from 1 September 2027 (LEGIARTI000048971734, which stems from Law No. 2023-29) contains none of them and restores the earlier wording. The discrepancy arose in the consolidation; the text published in the Official Journal is correct.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0021 — CGI art. 1600 on Légifrance, version for 2027: the 2026 Finance Act insertion on the Corsica chamber of commerce is missing
entry.summary: Reported. Article 135, VI, A, of Law No. 2026-103 (2026 Finance Act) inserts « et l'établissement public du commerce et de l'industrie de Corse » after « région » in I of article 1600 of the General Tax Code, with no end date. The version published on Légifrance for 1 January 2027 to 1 January 2028 (LEGIARTI000049534935) does not contain the insertion, while the preceding version (from 1 March 2026) and the versions for 2028 to 2030 do. The discrepancy arose in the consolidation; the text published in the Official Journal is correct.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0020 — CSS art. L. 136-4, IV, on Légifrance: the word « aux » dropped and « définiaux » run together after the 2026 social security financing act
entry.summary: Reported. We applied article 18, I, 2°, of Law No. 2025-1403 to the prior consolidated version of article L. 136-4, IV, of the Social Security Code and compared the result with the versions published on Légifrance (LEGIARTI000053282498 from 31 December 2025 and LEGIARTI000053284767 in force since 21 February 2026). The instruction replaces only « mêmes articles 64 bis et 76 », so the result reads « déterminés aux articles 50-0, 64 bis, 76 et 102 ter » and « du champ défini aux articles »; both versions read « déterminés articles » and « définiaux ». The discrepancy arose in the consolidation; the text published in the Official Journal is correct.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0019 — LF 2026 art. 81, V: « code général des collectivité territoriales » (missing plural in the name of the code)
entry.summary: Reported. Article 81, V, of Law No. 2026-103 (2026 Finance Act) introduces amendments to « La deuxième partie du code général des collectivité territoriales ». The code is the « code général des collectivités territoriales », as the same article writes it elsewhere. The final text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 227) carries the same spelling, so the discrepancy is in the adopted text; the code referred to remains identifiable.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0018 — LFSS 2026 art. 102, II, 3°: the title of Law No. 2025-199 misquoted as « de financement pour la sécurité sociale »
entry.summary: Reported. Article 102, II, 3°, of Law No. 2025-1403 (2026 social security financing act) cites « la loi n° 2025-199 du 28 février 2025 de financement pour la sécurité sociale pour 2025 ». The exact title, « de financement de la sécurité sociale pour 2025 », appears in IX of the same article. The text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 199 rect.) carries the same words, so the discrepancy is in the adopted text; the law referred to remains identifiable.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0017 — LFSS 2026 art. 12, II, 1°: Law No. 2016-1918 cited as a « financement » amending act instead of the amending finance act for 2016
entry.summary: Reported. Article 12, II, 1°, of Law No. 2025-1403 (2026 social security financing act) refers to « la loi n° 2016-1918 du 29 décembre 2016 de financement rectificative pour 2016 ». In the LEGI register of texts, Law No. 2016-1918 of 29 December 2016 is the amending finance act for 2016 (« de finances rectificative pour 2016 »). The text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 199 rect.) carries the same words, so the discrepancy is in the adopted text; the law referred to remains identifiable by its number and date.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0016 — LF 2026 art. 183, II: Law No. 2020-1721 cited with the date 9 December 2020 instead of 29 December 2020
entry.summary: Reported. Article 183, II, of Law No. 2026-103 (2026 Finance Act) amends article 225 of « la loi n° 2020-1721 du 9 décembre 2020 de finances pour 2021 ». Law No. 2020-1721 is dated 29 December 2020, and other articles of the same act, such as article 19, cite it with that date. The final text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 227) carries the same date, so the discrepancy is in the adopted text; the law referred to remains identifiable by its number.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0015 — CGI art. 199 sexdecies: the 2026 Finance Act replaces words that occur twice without saying which occurrence
entry.summary: Reported. We applied article 29, 2°, of Law No. 2026-103 (2026 Finance Act) to the prior consolidated text of article 199 sexdecies of the General Tax Code. Point a) inserts a second occurrence of the words « de l'article D. 7231-1 du même code »; point b) then replaces those words with « du même II » without saying which occurrence, and the sentence in force refers to services « mentionnés au 16° du II du même II ». The discrepancy is in the adopted text itself: the final text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 227) and the authenticated Official Journal No. 0043 carry the same wording.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0014 — LFSS 2026 art. 99, V, 4° b and c, and 6°: the published text omitted « first occurrence » where the anchor word occurs twice (corrected on 23 May 2026)
entry.summary: Corrected before our report. As published in the Official Journal of 31 December 2025, three insertions in article 99, V, of Law No. 2025-1403 were placed « après le mot : « enfant » » (7° and 8° of article L. 223-1 of the Social Security Code) and « après le mot : « travail » » (1° of article L. 351-3), while each word occurs twice in the provision amended. The text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 199 rect.) reads « après la première occurrence du mot », so the discrepancy arose at publication. The rectificatif published in Official Journal No. 0120 of 23 May 2026 had already restored the adopted wording before Arxo's check of 22 October 2026.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0013 — LFSS 2026 art. 18, II: the 2026 Finance Act cited under the number and date of the social security financing act itself (corrected on 23 May 2026)
entry.summary: Corrected before our report. As published in the Official Journal of 31 December 2025, article 18, II, of Law No. 2025-1403 (2026 social security financing act) referred to « la loi n° 2025-1403 du 30 décembre 2025 de finances pour 2026 », that is, to the 2026 Finance Act under the number and date of Law No. 2025-1403 itself. The text adopted by the National Assembly left the number and date blank, so the discrepancy arose at publication. The rectificatif published in Official Journal No. 0120 of 23 May 2026 had already corrected it before Arxo's check of 22 October 2026.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0010 — Camel grading, paragraph 23: the Russian electronic publication shows the word “ФОРМУЛА” instead of the live-weight formula
entry.summary: Reported. In the Russian card of the Әділет legal information system, paragraph 23 of the grading instructions for camels reads “by the formula: ФОРМУЛА”: the word “FORMULA” stands where the formula should be. The Kazakh card shows an image of the formula at the same place.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0009 — Maral and sika deer grading, paragraph 20: the weight threshold for class III hinds is “(ISO-IBS kg)” instead of a number
entry.summary: Reported. Paragraph 20 of the grading instructions for marals and sika deer assigns to class III the hinds “with a very low live weight (ISO-IBS kg)”: a placeholder stands where the weight should be. Class II is 170–184 kg, so a hind below 170 kg cannot be classed by weight. The Russian and Kazakh texts read the same way.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0008 — Beef cattle grading, paragraph 28: class I is written as “81-70 points”, so totals of 61–70 fall into no class
entry.summary: Reported. Paragraph 28 of the grading instructions for beef cattle sets “elite – 71-80 points”, “class I – 81-70 points” and “class II – 51-60 points”. A total of 61 to 70 points matches no row: a cow scoring 65 receives no class for the complex of traits. The Russian and Kazakh texts read the same way.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0007 — 26 U.S.C. §877(a)(2) substitutes “2003” for “1992” in §1(f)(3)(B), which no longer contains “1992”
entry.summary: Accepted by the addressee. Section 877(a)(2) adjusts the $124,000 tax-liability threshold for expatriates by the cost-of-living adjustment under section 1(f)(3) “by substituting ‘2003’ for ‘1992’ in subparagraph (B) thereof”. Section 1(f)(3)(B) no longer contains “1992”, so the substitution finds nothing to replace. The threshold is still used: §877A defines a covered expatriate through §877(a)(2).

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0006 — 26 U.S.C. §642(b)(2)(C)(iii)(II) indexes “the $4,150 amount in subparagraph (A)”, which holds $100
entry.summary: Accepted by the addressee. Subclause (II) increases “the $4,150 amount in subparagraph (A)” for inflation. Subparagraph (A) of §642(b)(2) contains $100; the $4,150 amount is in subclause (I) of the same clause, which substitutes it for the exemption amount while that amount is zero.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0005 — 26 U.S.C. §42(j)(5)(C)(i) refers to “subparagraph (B)(i)”, which has had no clauses since 1988
entry.summary: Accepted by the addressee. Section 42(j)(5)(C)(i) treats a husband and wife as one partner “for purposes of subparagraph (B)(i)”. Subparagraph (B) is a single sentence about partnerships with 35 or more partners and has had no clauses since P.L. 100-647 §4004(a) rewrote it.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0004 — 26 U.S.C. §42(i)(3)(C)(ii) defines a related person by reference to “subsection (d)(2)(D)(iii)”, which no longer exists
entry.summary: Accepted by the addressee. Section 42(i)(3)(C)(ii) excludes units owned by a person “related (as defined in subsection (d)(2)(D)(iii))” to the occupant. P.L. 110-289 §3003(e) and (g)(2) redesignated that definition as subsection (d)(2)(D)(ii), which now reads “(ii) Related person”; subparagraph (D) has no clause (iii).

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0003 — 26 U.S.C. §42(e)(3)(B) refers to “subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii)”, which no longer exists
entry.summary: Accepted by the addressee. Section 42(e)(3)(B) sets the credit for certain rehabilitation expenditures “using the percentage applicable under subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii)”. Subsection (b)(2)(B) has had no clauses since P.L. 110-289 §3002(a) restructured subsection (b); the 30 percent rule is now in subsection (b)(1)(B)(ii). The reference was not conformed when subsection (b) was rewritten.

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0002 — Instructions for Form 6251 (2025) cite 26 U.S.C. §56(b)(5)(D), which does not exist
entry.summary: Reported. The 2025 Instructions for Form 6251 say the enhanced deduction for seniors is treated as a personal exemption and added back to alternative minimum taxable income “as an adjustment under section 56(b)(5)(D)”. Section 56(b) has no paragraph (5); the disallowance of personal exemptions is in section 56(b)(1)(D).

entry.title: ARXO-2026-0001 — P.L. 119-21 §70204(a)(2)(A) quotes words that are not in 26 U.S.C. §529A(b)(2)(B)
entry.summary: Reported. The amending instruction inserts new words after “except as provided in the case of contributions under subsection (c)(1)(C)”. Section 529A(b)(2)(B) reads “except in the case of contributions under subsection (c)(1)(C)”: the quoted words do not occur, as written in 2014 and kept in later amendments. The Office of the Law Revision Counsel executed the insertion after the existing words to reflect the probable intent of Congress.
